# Anne Shirley & Dorothy

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) — intimate college friends · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P33](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0033), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.Weddings P4](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0004)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that a publisher accepted her sketch, bringing excitement to Patty's Place. While on a walk, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) announces his mother and sisters will visit, unnerving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Roy's family arrives a day early on Friday, creating chaos, but the awkward visit ends with Roy's sister [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) bonding with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P31](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0031)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling disillusioned after her breakup with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md). She hears updates about local news and engagements from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and Mrs. [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), serves as bridesmaid for Phil's wedding, and visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to meet her newborn baby boy.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings
